text.content:
Scrawled, water-stained, the ink run through with old damp:

"Tomkin — if you come in from the dark, I will ring you home. I will ring every night until you do. Forgive me that I did not ring in time. The bell remembers your name even when I cannot. — Mother"

GM: naming Tomkin or showing this note to Bellkeeper Sela grants advantage on the lay-to-rest check.
